name: SOC Alert Triage (enrich -> score -> respond)
description: Shuffle equivalent of the code-first soc-automation pipeline: a Wazuh alert is enriched (AbuseIPDB, VirusTotal, GeoIP), scored, and either auto-closed or escalated with a ticket + simulated containment. Mirrors the Python pipeline stage-for-stage.

triggers.name: Wazuh alert webhook
triggers.comment: Wazuh integrator POSTs the alert JSON here on any rule match.

actions.name: Extract IOCs
actions.comment: Pull srcip / user / hash / domain out of the Wazuh alert.

actions.name: AbuseIPDB reputation
actions.comment: Skipped automatically for private/lab IPs (no public reputation).

actions.name: Risk score
actions.comment: Same model as scoring.py: base = level/15*70, +30 from the top malicious signal; level >= 12 escalates on severity.

parameters.name: code
parameters.value:
base=round(min(15,int(rule_level))/15*70)
boost=30 if int(abuse_score)>=50 or int(vt_malicious)>0 else 0
score=min(100,base+boost)
action='escalate' if score>=70 or int(rule_level)>=12 else ('analyst_review' if score>=40 or int(vt_malicious)>0 else 'auto_close')
return {'score':score,'action':action}

actions.name: Branch on action
actions.comment: escalate -> ticket + containment; analyst_review -> ticket; auto_close -> log only.

actions.name: Create ticket + simulate containment
actions.comment: In a live setup this also triggers Wazuh active-response to block the IP / isolate the host. Simulated here.
